title: PAYEMS (Total Nonfarm Payroll Employment) — real-time vintage table of 2024 estimates as of 2024-09-06
text:
PAYEMS — Total Nonfarm Payroll Employment
Source: ALFRED (Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis archival FRED), series PAYEMS. Underlying data: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (CES). Units: thousands of persons, seasonally adjusted.
Revision schedule: monthly Employment Situation release, first Friday; each month the two prior months are revised.

VINTAGE TABLE — the value of PAYEMS for each reference month exactly as published on each pre-cutoff release (vintage) date. Reading across a row shows how the estimate for that month was revised in later releases.
